title: Multimodal CT-pathology imaging deep learning model for risk stratification in resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma
zh_title: CT-病理多模态深度学习用于I期肺腺癌风险分层

reason: 多中心外部验证并报告预后结局，属重要档
abstract: Lung adenocarcinoma is a highly heterogeneous disease, highlighting the need for more accurate prognosis prediction. We developed a multimodal deep learning model combining preoperative computed tomography (CT) and postoperative whole slide image (WSI) to predict the disease-free survival (DFS) of resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma. Based on a cohort of 1078 patients from multiple centers, our dual-information instance neural network achieved superior performance over unimodal approaches. The risk stratification defined by the model effectively distinguished DFS in both validation cohorts and served as an independent predictor, suggesting the complementary value of the model beyond clinicopathological factors. An exploratory scoring system integrating the model-derived risk stratification with key clinicopathological factors was developed, identifying patients with significantly different prognostic outcomes. Further analyses suggested that patients with high-risk stage IB disease or high scores might derive DFS benefit from adjuvant chemotherapy, warranting prospective validation. Beyond its predictive capacity, the model also provided morphological insights, identifying prognostically significant structures such as tertiary lymphoid structures and stroma barriers, while RNA-sequencing analysis revealed distinct oncogenic pathway activation and immunosuppressive tumor microenvironments in high-risk patients. By leveraging routinely acquired clinical images, this multimodal approach offers a practical tool for improving prognostic stratification, with potential implications for informing patient selection for adjuvant chemotherapy in resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma.
zh_abstract: 肺腺癌是一种高度异质性疾病，这凸显了对更准确预后预测的需求。我们开发了一种多模态深度学习模型，结合术前计算机断层扫描（CT）和术后全切片图像（WSI），以预测已切除的I期肺腺癌的无病生存期（DFS）。基于来自多个中心的1078例患者队列，我们的双信息实例神经网络取得了优于单模态方法的性能。该模型定义的风险分层在两个验证队列中均有效区分了DFS，并作为独立预测因子，提示该模型在临床病理因素之外具有互补价值。我们开发了一个探索性评分系统，将模型衍生的风险分层与关键临床病理因素整合，识别出预后结局显著不同的患者。进一步分析提示，高风险IB期疾病或高评分患者可能从辅助化疗中获得DFS获益，值得前瞻性验证。除预测能力外，该模型还提供了形态学见解，识别出具有预后意义的结构，如三级淋巴结构和间质屏障，而RNA测序分析揭示高风险患者中存在不同的致癌通路激活和免疫抑制性肿瘤微环境。通过利用常规获取的临床图像，这种多模态方法提供了一种改善预后分层的实用工具，并可能对指导已切除I期肺腺癌患者辅助化疗的患者选择具有潜在意义。

title: Reimagining inflammatory bowel disease in the age of artificial intelligence: discovery, care, education, and sustainability for the next decade.
zh_title: AI时代炎症性肠病的未来十年展望
summary: 观点文章讨论多模态基础模型如何重塑炎症性肠病的科学发现、诊疗、教育与可持续性。

abstract: [Journal of Crohn's & colitis] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly evolving from task-specific algorithms to multimodal foundation models capable of integrating heterogeneous biological and clinical data across the health-care continuum. In inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), this transformation offers an unprecedented opportunity to move beyond fragmented analyses toward a unified understanding and management of disease. Artificial intelligence is emerging as the connective infrastructure linking scientific discovery, therapeutic development, patient care, education, and health-care delivery systems into continuously learning ecosystems. In this viewpoint, we explore how AI may reshape IBD over the next decade through 5 interconnected domains. Advances in multimodal AI accelerate biological discovery by integrating multiomics, spatial biology, and foundation models to identify mechanistic disease endotypes. Simultaneously, AI can shorten the path from molecular discovery to therapeutic innovation by supporting target identification, predicting protein structure, drug positioning, and adaptive clinical trial design. These scientific advances converge at the bedside, where multimodal AI may transform patient care from reactive management to predictive precision medicine through integrated diagnostics, digital biomarkers, real-time monitoring and individualized risk prediction. Beyond clinical care, AI is redefining medical education by enabling adaptive learning, explainable decision support, and democratized specialist expertise, while contributing to sustainable health care through optimized resource allocation, workforce support, and continuously learning systems. Realizing this vision will require robust governance, interoperability, prospective validation, and equitable implementation. If responsibly deployed, AI holds the potential to redefine IBD diagnosis, classification, therapeutic strategies and management within an intelligent ecosystem able to accelerate discovery, personalize care, and improve outcomes for patients and health-care systems alike.
zh_abstract: [Journal of Crohn's & colitis] 人工智能（AI）正迅速从任务特定算法演变为能够整合贯穿医疗保健连续体的异质性生物学和临床数据的多模态基础模型。在炎症性肠病（IBD）中，这一转变提供了前所未有的机会，使人们能够超越碎片化分析，转向对疾病的统一理解和管理。人工智能正在成为连接性基础设施，将科学发现、治疗开发、患者护理、教育和医疗保健提供系统连接成持续学习的生态系统。在这篇观点文章中，我们探讨AI在未来十年如何通过5个相互关联的领域重塑IBD。多模态AI的进步通过整合多组学、空间生物学和基础模型来识别机制性疾病内型，从而加速生物学发现。同时，AI可通过支持靶点识别、预测蛋白质结构、药物定位和适应性临床试验设计，缩短从分子发现到治疗创新的路径。这些科学进展汇聚于床旁，在那里多模态AI可能通过整合诊断、数字生物标志物、实时监测和个体化风险预测，将患者护理从反应性管理转变为预测性精准医学。除临床护理外，AI正在重新定义医学教育，通过实现自适应学习、可解释决策支持和专科专业知识的民主化，同时通过优化资源分配、劳动力支持和持续学习系统为可持续医疗保健做出贡献。实现这一愿景将需要稳健的治理、互操作性、前瞻性验证和公平实施。如果负责任地部署，AI有潜力在能够加速发现、个性化护理并改善患者和医疗保健系统结局的智能生态系统中重新定义IBD的诊断、分类、治疗策略和管理。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University; conditions: Pulmonary Nodules, Lung Cancer (Diagnosis); type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 1000; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study will test how well an existing artificial intelligence (AI) model can use photos of the surface of the eyes to tell whether lung nodules are benign or cancerous. The study plans to enroll 1,000 adults at several hospitals in China. Their lung nodules have already been found on a chest CT scan, and their doctors have already scheduled surgery as part of usual care. The research team will take photos of both eyes before surgery and compare the AI results with the findings from routine laboratory examination of the tissue removed during surgery. The AI results are for research only and will not guide patient care. The study does not require additional CT scans, blood draws, or long-term follow-up. The findings will inform future studies of whether eye photos could help identify people who may benefit from chest CT screening.

title: Medical Specialty Prediction from Bangla Patient Narratives: A Comparative Study of ML, DL, Transformers, and LLMs
zh_title: 从孟加拉语患者自述预测就诊专科的模型比较
summary: 比较机器学习、深度学习、Transformer与LLM从孟加拉语患者自述预测就诊专科，XLM-RoBERTa最佳，准确率86.26%。
key_points: 语料3798条、20个专科，取5个专科2730条
XLM-RoBERTa准确率86.26%、宏F1 86.21%
所有模型共用同一80:20内部划分，无外部验证
reason: 规范的回顾性模型比较，但仅内部划分、无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Timely access to appropriate medical specialists remains a bottleneck in Bangladesh's healthcare system, as patients describe symptoms in informal Bangla rather than clinical terms, leading to ineffective referrals. This paper compares four model families for predicting medical specialties from Bangla patient narratives: six machine learning (ML) models using hybrid TF-IDF features, four deep learning (DL) models using Word2Vec embeddings trained on the corpus, four fine-tuned transformers, and five large language models (LLMs) evaluated zero-shot. From a corpus of 3798 patient records covering 20 specialties, we retained the five with the most records (Medicine, Gynecology, Dermatology, Pediatrics, Gastroenterology) and split the resulting 2730 records 80:20 into training and test sets shared by all families. The best transformer was XLM-RoBERTa (86.26% accuracy, 86.21% macro-F1), the best ML model was SVM (84.98%, 84.92%), the best DL model was Bidirectional GRU (80.77%, 80.83%), and the best LLM was Gemini (90.29%, 90.15%). Holm-corrected paired McNemar tests show SVM significantly outperforming Bi-LSTM (adjusted p = 0.004), whereas the Gemini-versus-Grok gap does not survive correction (adjusted p = 0.104), and neither the strongest transformer versus the weakest LLM (Grok) nor SVM versus the strongest transformer reaches significance. A tuned classical model is thus statistically indistinguishable from the strongest transformer, so accuracy rankings alone should not be read as evidence of one family's superiority. The findings provide a comparative baseline for Bangla medical text classification.
zh_abstract: 在孟加拉国医疗保健系统中，及时获得合适的专科医生仍然是一个瓶颈，因为患者用非正式孟加拉语而非临床术语描述症状，导致转诊无效。本文比较了四类模型家族，用于从孟加拉语患者叙述中预测医学专科：使用混合TF-IDF特征的六个机器学习（ML）模型、使用在语料库上训练的Word2Vec嵌入的四个深度学习（DL）模型、四个微调Transformer以及五个以零样本方式评估的大语言模型（LLM）。从涵盖20个专科的3798份患者记录语料库中，我们保留了记录最多的五个专科（内科、妇科、皮肤科、儿科、胃肠病学），并将所得的2730份记录按80:20分为所有模型家族共享的训练集和测试集。最佳Transformer为XLM-RoBERTa（准确率86.26%，宏F1 86.21%），最佳ML模型为SVM（84.98%，84.92%），最佳DL模型为双向GRU（80.77%，80.83%），最佳LLM为Gemini（90.29%，90.15%）。Holm校正的配对McNemar检验显示，SVM显著优于Bi-LSTM（校正后P = 0.004），而Gemini与Grok之间的差距未通过校正（校正后P = 0.104），并且最强Transformer与最弱LLM（Grok）之间以及SVM与最强Transformer之间均未达到显著性。因此，经调优的经典模型在统计学上与最强Transformer无法区分，所以仅凭准确率排名不应被解读为某一模型家族更优的证据。这些发现为孟加拉语医学文本分类提供了比较基线。
